# Mayak — Sub-project 1 (multi-session core) Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Turn the single-session Coucou island into Mayak: a Windows island that shows every live Claude Code and Codex session, grouped by project, with who-is-waiting, live overview and completion/error alerts.

**Architecture:** I/O threads (claude-io, codex-io, exit waiters) send precomputed facts to one pure Rust model (`Store::apply` → alerts + effects); a store thread publishes snapshots to the TypeScript island, which only renders. Claude is observed passively; Codex through opt-in, observe-only turn-level hooks.

**Tech Stack:** Tauri 2, Rust (windows 0.61, serde, std threads), TypeScript (no framework), PowerShell for spikes.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-01-mayak-multi-session-core-design.md`
**Interface contract (binding for names and types):** `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-01-mayak-multi-session-core-contract.md`

## Global Constraints

- Windows only (`windows/`); `NotchBuddy/` is not touched. No new crates; only extra features of `windows` 0.61.
- Identifiers: slug `mayak`, dir `Mayak`, `mayak-hook.exe`, pipe `\.pipemayak-<SID>`, marker `mayak-hook` (legacy `coucou-hook` recognised for status/removal only), bundle id `io.github.mahach666.mayak`.
- Never block or slow an agent: the relay always exits 0 within its budget; Codex events never wait and print nothing; the island never answers Codex.
- No tool-config writes by default. `~/.codex/hooks.json` only via exact-bytes diff + dated backup + explicit click; never write `[hooks.state]`/`trusted_hash`. `~/.claude/settings.json` only for the opt-in legacy Allow/Deny target (PermissionRequest only).
- Never open `*.key`, `ide/*.lock`, `auth.json`, `config.toml`, `claude_desktop_config.json`. Logs hold keys/phases/counts only — no transcript text, tool input or secrets.
- 0% CPU while hidden: no timers while hidden (the Codex 1 Hz tail ticker runs only while the island is visible).
- No approval without an explicit click. Island text stays English.
- Commits: plain conventional messages, no AI attribution and no Co-Authored-By trailers.
- Checks: `cd windows && cargo test --workspace` (needs `target/release/mayak-hook.exe`: run `npm run build` or `cargo build --release -p mayak-hook` first) and `npx tsc --noEmit`.
- Gates: Task 2 (spike S1) is BLOCKING — a FAIL stops work before Task 3. Spikes S2–S5 run in Task 15 (decision D69).

## Review Focus

- Fast turn or immediate API error: claude-io reads idle → idle with only a new statusUpdatedAt → it drains the transcript before ClaudeFile, the model computes the collapsed turn's outcome, and exactly one Finished alert is raised; repeated notifications raise nothing more. — test: `observe::claude::io_thread::tests::a_collapsed_turn_is_read_before_its_file_and_alerts_once` (T11)
- Mayak starts or restarts while a Claude session already waits on a permission prompt → the row is listed with the title from the start window, counted (waiting 1), hold=true, aggregate Approval, no alert; a later rewrite in the same episode (updatedAt) raises no alert either. — test: `observe::claude::io_thread::tests::sessions_already_waiting_at_start_are_listed_and_held_without_alerts` (T11)
- /clear (same pid, new sessionId) → the model's Untrack + Track reach claude-io; a later write and the removal of the old transcript produce no signal and no crash; the new transcript binds at 0, and only the new turn's reply becomes the outcome (one Finished alert). — test: `observe::claude::io_thread::tests::a_cleared_session_lets_the_old_transcript_go_and_counts_only_the_new_one` (T11)
- Mayak quits or crashes while a Claude PermissionRequest relay waits (110 s DECISION_BUDGET) → the closed pipe makes talk_to return None at once (~300 ms here), the relay prints nothing and the terminal takes over. — test: `tests::a_server_that_goes_away_frees_a_waiting_relay_at_once` (T3)
- Claude Desktop at C:\Users\dev\Mayak plus Claude in Cursor at c:/users/dev/mayak/windows/src-tauri/ (cwd resolved by paths::project_of) → one project card (key c:\users\dev\mayak, name Mayak, root C:\Users\dev\Mayak) with rows for ClaudeDesktop and Cursor; the subfolder session's alert says 'Claude · Mayak (Cursor) asks'. — test: `observe::model::tests::desktop_and_cursor_sessions_in_a_repo_and_its_subfolder_share_one_project` (T9)

- lines 1–16 (module doc): replace the whole block with
```rust
//! mayak-hook — the relay Claude Code runs on every hook event.
//!
//! Reads the hook JSON on stdin, adds a little terminal context, and hands it to
//! Mayak over the named pipe `\\.\pipe\mayak-<sid>`.
//!
//! Hard rule (docs/CLAUDE.md): **never block Claude Code.**
//! * If the pipe does not exist — Mayak is closed — we exit 0 immediately with
//!   nothing on stdout, and the session carries on untouched.
//! * Every step runs under a deadline enforced by the main thread, so a pipe that
//!   accepts the connection and then stops reading cannot wedge the session
//!   either: we abandon the worker and exit.
//! * Only `PermissionRequest` waits for an answer, because approving from the
//!   island is the whole point. No answer means empty stdout, and Claude Code
//!   asks in the terminal exactly as if Mayak were not installed.
//!
//! Usage: `mayak-hook <EventName>` (the name is also read from the JSON).
```

```rust
/// `\\.\pipe\coucou-<sid>`. The SID keeps two accounts on the same machine from
/// ever meeting on the same pipe; the name falls back to the user name only if
/// the SID cannot be read at all, which should not happen.
fn pipe_path() -> String {
    let key = win::current_user_sid()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::env::var("USERNAME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "user".into()));
    format!(r"\\.\pipe\coucou-{key}")
}
```
with

```rust
/// `\\.\pipe\mayak-<sid>`. The SID keeps two accounts on the same machine from

fn pipe_path() -> String {
    let key = win::current_user_sid()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::env::var("USERNAME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "user".into()));
    format!(r"\\.\pipe\{}{key}", ident::PIPE_PREFIX)
}
```

```rust
        if let Some(parent) = exe.parent() {
            // Installed build, then `tauri dev` (target/debug) next to the
            // release hook the pre-build step produces.
            candidates.push(parent.join(HOOK_EXE));
            candidates.push(parent.join("../release").join(HOOK_EXE));
            // Belt and braces: where the old glob form used to land it.
            candidates.push(parent.join("_up_/target/release").join(HOOK_EXE));
        }
    }

    let tried: Vec<String> = candidates.iter().map(|p| p.display().to_string()).collect();
    let Some(src) = candidates.into_iter().find(|p| p.exists()) else {
        crate::log::line(format!(
            "{HOOK_EXE} not found — Claude Code hooks cannot work. Looked in: {}",
            tried.join(", ")
        ));
        return;
    };
```

Create `windows/src-tauri/src/testutil.rs`:
```rust
// Test-only helpers shared by the app's unit tests (`#[cfg(test)]` in lib.rs).

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};

static NEXT: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);

/// A fresh, empty directory `%TEMP%\mayak-test-<tag>-<pid>-<n>`, removed with
/// everything in it when the value is dropped. `n` makes every call unique
/// inside one test binary, `pid` keeps parallel test binaries apart.
pub struct TempDir {
    pub path: PathBuf,
}

impl TempDir {
    pub fn new(tag: &str) -> TempDir {
        let n = NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "mayak-test-{tag}-{}-{n}",
            std::process::id()
        ));
        // A crashed earlier run with a recycled pid may have left this behind.
        if path.exists() {
            std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path)
                .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("cannot clear {}: {e}", path.display()));
        }
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&path)
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("cannot create {}: {e}", path.display()));
        TempDir { path }
    }
}

impl Drop for TempDir {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // Never panic in drop (a failing test is already unwinding); say it instead.
        if let Err(err) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&self.path) {
            eprintln!("could not remove {}: {err}", self.path.display());
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
fn settings_path() -> PathBuf {
    config_dir().join(SETTINGS_FILE)
}

/// One-time migration from Coucou: copies `<appdata>\Coucou\settings.json` to
/// `<appdata>\Mayak\settings.json` when Mayak has no settings file yet and the
/// Coucou one exists. The Coucou file and folder are left exactly as they are.
/// `Ok(true)` when a copy was made; `Ok(false)` when there was nothing to do.
pub fn copy_legacy_settings(appdata: &Path) -> std::io::Result<bool> {
    let target = appdata.join(ident::APP_DIR).join(SETTINGS_FILE);
    match std::fs::metadata(&target) {
        Ok(_) => return Ok(false),
        Err(err) if err.kind() == ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
        // Unknown state of our own file: refuse rather than risk overwriting it.
        Err(err) => return Err(err),
    }
    let source = appdata.join(ident::LEGACY_DIR).join(SETTINGS_FILE);
    match std::fs::metadata(&source) {
        Ok(meta) if meta.is_file() => {}
        Ok(_) => return Ok(false),
        Err(err) if err.kind() == ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(false),
        Err(err) => return Err(err),
    }
    std::fs::create_dir_all(appdata.join(ident::APP_DIR))?;
    std::fs::copy(&source, &target)?;
    Ok(true)
}

pub fn load() -> Settings {
    match copy_legacy_settings(&appdata_dir()) {
        Ok(true) => crate::log::line("settings: copied the Coucou settings.json"),
        Ok(false) => {}
        Err(err) => crate::log::line(format!("settings: Coucou settings.json not copied: {err}")),
    }
    match std::fs::read(settings_path()) {
```

### Task 2: Spike S1 (BLOCKING, no product code): Cursor permission-prompt check of ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json + transcript ordering, run with the user (spec §12 S1)

Goal (spec §12 S1): in Cursor, while Claude Code shows a permission prompt, (C1) the session file becomes
`status: waiting`, `waitingFor: "permission prompt"` and the directory watcher **reports** the write;
(C2) the `tool_use` record is in the transcript before the user answers; (C3) the turn's final assistant
record lands near the `idle` transition. Desktop `input needed` is already confirmed (spec §3).
Negative result → implementation stops and the Claude path is redesigned with the user.

**Files:**
- Create (outside the repo, not committed): `%TEMP%\mayak-s1\watch-s1.ps1` (observer), log `%TEMP%\mayak-s1\s1.log`,
  probe folder `C:\tmp\mayak-s1`
- Create (untracked, inside `.git`): `$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/mayak-pr-notes.md`
- Test: the decision rule in Step 6 applied to `s1.log`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing from the product (the observer is standalone; T1 is not required).
- Produces: S1 verdict (PASS / PASS WITH NOTE / FAIL) in `mayak-pr-notes.md` (contract §6 T2, D3); go/no-go for Task 3.

The observer is read-only. It never opens `*.key` files (name filter `^[0-9]+\.json$`), and for
transcripts it prints only record type, `isSidechain`, `stop_reason`, `isApiErrorMessage` and block
kinds (tool names and the last 6 characters of tool ids) — never message text, tool input or prompts.
It was smoke-tested against a simulated session/transcript (busy → tool_use → waiting → busy →
tool_result → end_turn → idle), against a new transcript whose first records are written before the
session file names its sessionId (all three records printed, from `@0`), with `-AnyFile` under 300
back-to-back session-file + transcript writes (no crash, `STOP` reached), and against the live
`~/.claude` (START/INIT path). Watcher notifications go through a .NET queue, not PowerShell's event
queue: Windows PowerShell 5.1 gave two notifications of different watchers the same `EventIdentifier`,
and `Remove-Event` then ended the observer silently.

Two probes run in one Cursor conversation: **P1 Bash** (a shell-command permission, primary — acceptance
item 2 and spec §10 «цель кодом» are about commands) and **P2 Write** (a file-edit permission, second).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the observer script**

Create `%TEMP%\mayak-s1\watch-s1.ps1` (PowerShell: `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$env:TEMP\mayak-s1" | Out-Null`, then write the file) with exactly:

```powershell
<#
  Spike S1 (Mayak sub-project 1, spec section 12). Read-only observer.

  Watches <ClaudeDir>\sessions (only names matching ^[0-9]+\.json$; *.key files are
  never opened) and <ClaudeDir>\projects\**\*.jsonl, and prints one line per
  notification with metadata only: status fields of session files, and for
  transcript records the record type, stop_reason, API-error flag and content
  block kinds (tool names and the last 6 chars of tool ids). Message text, tool
  input, prompts and file contents are never printed or written.

  A 250 ms poller re-reads the session files independently. When the poller sees
  a new state and no watcher notification for that file arrived within 1 s of it,
  the script prints MISSED-NOTIFY: that is the "notification" half of S1.

  -Entrypoint * tails the transcripts of every session (default: claude-vscode).
  -AnyFile also prints one FILE line (relative path only; the file is never
  opened) for every notification about any file under sessions and projects,
  as Mayak's own directory watchers see them (acceptance item 5b).
  Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatible. Stops after -DurationSec or on Ctrl+C.
#>
param(
    [string]$ClaudeDir = $(if ($env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.claude' }),
    [string]$LogPath = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mayak-s1\s1.log'),
    [string]$Entrypoint = 'claude-vscode',
    [int]$DurationSec = 900,
    [int]$PollMs = 250,
    [switch]$AnyFile
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$sessionsDir = Join-Path $ClaudeDir 'sessions'
$projectsDir = Join-Path $ClaudeDir 'projects'
$logDir = Split-Path -Parent $LogPath
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $logDir | Out-Null }

function Write-S1([datetime]$At, [string]$Message) {
    $line = '{0:HH:mm:ss.fff} {1}' -f $At, $Message
    Write-Host $line
    Add-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
}

function Get-Tail6([object]$Value) {
    $s = [string]$Value
    if ($s.Length -le 6) { return $s }
    return $s.Substring($s.Length - 6)
}

function Get-Head8([string]$Value) {
    if ($Value.Length -le 8) { return $Value }
    return $Value.Substring(0, 8)
}

function Read-Shared([string]$Path, [long]$Offset) {
    # FileShare ReadWrite|Delete: never get in the agent's way.
    $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($Path, [System.IO.FileMode]::Open, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Read,
        [System.IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite -bor [System.IO.FileShare]::Delete)
    try {
        $len = $fs.Length
        if ($len -lt $Offset) { $Offset = 0 }
        $count = [int]($len - $Offset)
        $buf = New-Object byte[] $count
        $fs.Position = $Offset
        $read = 0
        while ($read -lt $count) {
            $r = $fs.Read($buf, $read, $count - $read)
            if ($r -le 0) { break }
            $read += $r
        }
        return @{ Offset = $Offset; Bytes = $buf; Count = $read }
    } finally {
        $fs.Dispose()
    }
}

function Get-HostKind([string]$Image) {
    if (-not $Image) { return 'unknown' }
    $k = $Image.ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($k -match '\\\.cursor\\extensions\\anthropic\.claude-code-') { return 'cursor' }
    if ($k -match '\\\.vscode\\extensions\\anthropic\.claude-code-') { return 'vscode' }
    if ($k -match '\\packages\\claude_[^\\]*\\localcache\\roaming\\claude\\claude-code\\' -or
        $k -match '\\claude\\claude-code\\[^\\]+\\claude\.exe$') { return 'desktop' }
    return 'other'
}

$sids = @{}          # sessionId -> $true for sessions whose entrypoint matches -Entrypoint
$pollState = @{}     # file name -> last state string seen by the poller
$lastEventAt = @{}   # file name -> TimeGenerated of the last watcher notification
$pending = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList   # poller changes awaiting a notification
$offsets = @{}       # transcript full path -> byte offset already consumed

function Read-SessionFile([string]$Name) {
    $path = Join-Path $sessionsDir $Name
    $raw = Read-Shared $path 0
    $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($raw.Bytes, 0, $raw.Count)
    try {
        $f = $text | ConvertFrom-Json
    } catch {
        return @{ Ok = $false; Text = ('parse-failed len={0}' -f $raw.Count); State = 'unparsed' }
    }
    $state = 'status={0} waitingFor={1} statusUpdatedAt={2}' -f $f.status, $(if ($f.waitingFor) { $f.waitingFor } else { '-' }), $f.statusUpdatedAt
    $image = $null; $match = 'no-process'
    $proc = if ($f.pid) { Get-Process -Id ([int]$f.pid) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { $null }
    if ($proc) {
        $image = $proc.Path
        $match = if ([string]$proc.StartTime.ToFileTimeUtc() -eq [string]$f.procStart) { 'match' } else { 'MISMATCH' }
    }
    $sid = [string]$f.sessionId
    if ($f.entrypoint -eq $Entrypoint -and $sid) { $sids[$sid] = $true }
    $cwdLeaf = if ($f.cwd) { Split-Path -Leaf ([string]$f.cwd) } else { '-' }
    $line = 'pid={0} sid={1} entry={2} host={3} procStart={4} version={5} cwd={6} {7}' -f `
        $f.pid, (Get-Head8 $sid), $f.entrypoint,
        (Get-HostKind $image), $match, $f.version, $cwdLeaf, $state
    return @{ Ok = $true; Text = $line; State = $state }
}

function Show-Transcript([datetime]$At, [string]$Path) {
    $sid = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($Path)
    if ($Entrypoint -ne '*' -and -not $sids.ContainsKey($sid)) { return }
    # Every transcript that existed at START is in $offsets already, so an
    # unknown path is a file created since then: read it from the beginning.
    if (-not $offsets.ContainsKey($Path)) { $offsets[$Path] = 0 }
    $raw = Read-Shared $Path $offsets[$Path]
    if ($raw.Offset -lt $offsets[$Path]) { Write-S1 $At ('TX {0} file shrank, restarting at 0' -f (Get-Head8 $sid)) }
    $start = 0
    while ($start -lt $raw.Count) {
        $nl = [Array]::IndexOf($raw.Bytes, [byte]10, $start, $raw.Count - $start)
        if ($nl -lt 0) { break }   # incomplete last line: keep it for the next read
        $lineOffset = $raw.Offset + $start
        $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($raw.Bytes, $start, $nl - $start).Trim().TrimStart([char]0xFEFF)
        $start = $nl + 1
        if (-not $text) { continue }
        try { $r = $text | ConvertFrom-Json } catch {
            Write-S1 $At ('TX {0} @{1} unparsed len={2}' -f (Get-Head8 $sid), $lineOffset, $text.Length)
            continue
        }
        $m = $r.message
        $blocks = @()
        if ($m -and ($m.content -is [string])) {
            $blocks += $(if ($m.content.Contains('[Request interrupted by user')) { 'string(interrupt)' } else { 'string' })
        } elseif ($m -and $m.content) {
            foreach ($b in @($m.content)) {
                switch ([string]$b.type) {
                    'tool_use'    { $blocks += ('tool_use:{0}#{1}' -f $b.name, (Get-Tail6 $b.id)) }
                    'tool_result' { $blocks += ('tool_result#{0}' -f (Get-Tail6 $b.tool_use_id)) }
                    'text'        { $blocks += $(if (([string]$b.text).Contains('[Request interrupted by user')) { 'text(interrupt)' } else { 'text' }) }
                    default       { $blocks += [string]$b.type }
                }
            }
        }
        $stop = if ($m) { [string]$m.stop_reason } else { '' }
        Write-S1 $At ('TX {0} @{1} type={2} side={3} stop={4} apiErr={5} blocks={6}' -f `
            (Get-Head8 $sid), $lineOffset, $r.type, $r.isSidechain, $stop, $r.isApiErrorMessage, ($blocks -join ','))
    }
    $offsets[$Path] = $raw.Offset + $start
}

# Watcher threads put notifications into a .NET queue. PowerShell's own event queue
# is not used: Windows PowerShell 5.1 can give two events raised at the same moment
# by different watchers the same EventIdentifier, and Remove-Event then throws.
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.IO;
public sealed class S1Note {
    public DateTime At;
    public string Tag;
    public string Kind;
    public string Name;
    public string FullPath;
    public string Error;
}
public static class S1Queue {
    public static readonly ConcurrentQueue<S1Note> Items = new ConcurrentQueue<S1Note>();
    static void Add(string tag, string kind, string name, string fullPath, string error) {
        S1Note n = new S1Note();
        n.At = DateTime.Now; n.Tag = tag; n.Kind = kind; n.Name = name; n.FullPath = fullPath; n.Error = error;
        Items.Enqueue(n);
    }
    public static void Attach(FileSystemWatcher w, string tag) {
        w.Changed += (s, e) => Add(tag, "Changed", e.Name, e.FullPath, null);
        w.Created += (s, e) => Add(tag, "Created", e.Name, e.FullPath, null);
        w.Deleted += (s, e) => Add(tag, "Deleted", e.Name, e.FullPath, null);
        w.Renamed += (s, e) => Add(tag, "Renamed", e.Name, e.FullPath, null);
        w.Error += (s, e) => Add(tag, "Error", null, null, e.GetException().Message);
    }
}
"@

function New-Watcher([string]$Dir, [string]$Filter, [bool]$Recurse, [string]$Tag) {
    $w = New-Object System.IO.FileSystemWatcher
    $w.Path = $Dir
    $w.Filter = $Filter
    $w.IncludeSubdirectories = $Recurse
    $w.NotifyFilter = [System.IO.NotifyFilters]'FileName, LastWrite, Size'
    $w.InternalBufferSize = 65536
    [S1Queue]::Attach($w, $Tag)
    $w.EnableRaisingEvents = $true
    return $w
}

$watchers = @()
try {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sessionsDir)) { throw "missing $sessionsDir" }
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $projectsDir)) { throw "missing $projectsDir" }
    $watchers += New-Watcher $sessionsDir '*.json' $false 'sessions'
    $watchers += New-Watcher $projectsDir '*.jsonl' $true 'projects'
    if ($AnyFile) {
        $watchers += New-Watcher $sessionsDir '*' $false 'anysessions'
        $watchers += New-Watcher $projectsDir '*' $true 'anyprojects'
    }

    $existing = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $projectsDir -Recurse -File -Filter '*.jsonl')
    foreach ($t in $existing) { $offsets[$t.FullName] = $t.Length }
    $names = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $sessionsDir -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^[0-9]+\.json$' })
    Write-S1 (Get-Date) ('START claude={0} sessions={1} transcripts={2} entrypoint={3} log={4}' -f `
        $ClaudeDir, $names.Count, $existing.Count, $Entrypoint, $LogPath)
    foreach ($n in $names) {
        $s = Read-SessionFile $n.Name
        $pollState[$n.Name] = $s.State
        Write-S1 (Get-Date) ('INIT {0} {1}' -f $n.Name, $s.Text)
    }

    $end = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($DurationSec)
    while ((Get-Date) -lt $end) {
        $q = $null
        while ([S1Queue]::Items.TryDequeue([ref]$q)) {
            $at = $q.At; $tag = $q.Tag; $kind = $q.Kind
            if ($kind -eq 'Error') {
                Write-S1 $at ('OVERFLOW-OR-ERROR {0}: {1}' -f $tag, $q.Error)
                continue
            }
            if ($tag -like 'any*') {
                # -AnyFile: every kind wakes Mayak's watcher, so every kind is logged; never opened.
                Write-S1 $at ('FILE {0}\{1}' -f $tag.Substring(3), $q.Name)
                continue
            }
            if ($tag -eq 'sessions') {
                if ($q.Name -notmatch '^[0-9]+\.json$') { continue }
                $lastEventAt[$q.Name] = $at
                if ($kind -eq 'Deleted') { Write-S1 $at ('EVENT Deleted {0}' -f $q.Name); continue }
                try { $s = Read-SessionFile $q.Name } catch { Write-S1 $at ('EVENT {0} {1} read-failed: {2}' -f $kind, $q.Name, $_.Exception.Message); continue }
                Write-S1 $at ('EVENT {0} {1} {2}' -f $kind, $q.Name, $s.Text)
            } else {
                if ($kind -eq 'Deleted') { continue }
                try { Show-Transcript $at $q.FullPath } catch { Write-S1 $at ('TX read-failed: {0}' -f $_.Exception.Message) }
            }
        }

        # Independent poller: the cross-check for missed notifications.
        $now = Get-Date
        foreach ($n in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $sessionsDir -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^[0-9]+\.json$' })) {
            try { $s = Read-SessionFile $n.Name } catch { continue }
            if ($pollState[$n.Name] -ne $s.State) {
                $pollState[$n.Name] = $s.State
                Write-S1 $now ('POLL {0} {1}' -f $n.Name, $s.State)
                [void]$pending.Add(@{ Name = $n.Name; At = $now; State = $s.State })
            }
        }
        foreach ($p in @($pending)) {
            if (($now - $p.At).TotalMilliseconds -lt 1000) { continue }
            $seen = $lastEventAt.ContainsKey($p.Name) -and (($lastEventAt[$p.Name] - $p.At).TotalMilliseconds -ge -1000)
            if (-not $seen) { Write-S1 $now ('MISSED-NOTIFY {0} {1}' -f $p.Name, $p.State) }
            $pending.Remove($p)
        }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $PollMs
    }
    Write-S1 (Get-Date) 'STOP duration reached'
} finally {
    foreach ($w in $watchers) { $w.EnableRaisingEvents = $false; $w.Dispose() }
}
```

```powershell
[void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile("$env:TEMP\mayak-s1\watch-s1.ps1", [ref]$t, [ref]$e)
"parse errors: " + $e.Count
```

```powershell
Remove-Item -LiteralPath "$env:TEMP\mayak-s1\s1.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Start the observer in the background**

Run in the background (agent background task), PowerShell:
`powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:TEMP\mayak-s1\watch-s1.ps1" -Entrypoint '*' -DurationSec 1200`
(`-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` applies to this one process only. `-Entrypoint '*'` tails every transcript
from its first write: with the default filter, a record written before the session file names the new
sessionId would only be printed at the next transcript write, with a late time, which would skew C2.
Step 5 filters the TX lines by sid, so `*` only adds metadata lines of other sessions.)

Expected within 3 s in `%TEMP%\mayak-s1\s1.log`:
```
HH:mm:ss.fff START claude=C:\Users\HP\.claude sessions=<n> transcripts=<m> entrypoint=* log=…\mayak-s1\s1.log
HH:mm:ss.fff INIT <pid>.json pid=<pid> sid=<8 hex> entry=claude-vscode host=cursor procStart=match version=2.1.<x> cwd=<folder> status=idle waitingFor=- statusUpdatedAt=<ms>
```
(one INIT line per live session; Desktop sessions show `entry=claude-desktop host=desktop`). A
`throw "missing …\sessions"` means `~/.claude/sessions` does not exist → S1 FAIL (Step 6, rule F5).

- [ ] **Step 4: Ask the user to run the probe in Cursor**

Send the user this message and wait for their reply «готово»:

> 1. В Cursor: File → Open Folder → `C:\tmp\mayak-s1` (новое окно).
> 2. Откройте панель Claude Code и начните **новый** разговор. Внизу панели режим разрешений должен быть «Ask before edits» (не «Edit automatically» и не bypass).
> 3. Отправьте ровно: `Run the shell command: echo ok > s1-bash.txt and then reply with exactly: done`
> 4. Когда появится запрос разрешения на команду — **подождите 5 секунд**, затем нажмите «Yes» (не «Yes, and don't ask again»).
> 5. Дождитесь ответа `done`, подождите ещё 10 секунд.
> 6. В том же разговоре отправьте ровно: `Create a file named s1-probe.txt in this folder containing the single word ok. Then reply with exactly: done`
> 7. Когда появится запрос разрешения на запись файла — **подождите 5 секунд**, затем нажмите «Yes».
> 8. Дождитесь ответа `done`, подождите ещё 10 секунд.
> 9. (Необязательно, для полноты) Отправьте: `Use the AskUserQuestion tool to ask me whether I prefer tea or coffee, then reply with exactly: noted` — подождите 5 секунд, ответьте на вопрос, дождитесь `noted`.
> 10. Напишите «готово» и, если какой-то запрос разрешения не появился, — какой.

None of the user's `permissions.allow` rules in `~/.claude/settings.json` (all `Bash(dotnet …)`,
`Bash(powershell -File:*)`, `Bash(python…)`) matches `echo`, and the `>` redirect makes it a write, so P1
is expected to prompt. Fallbacks, each sent in the
same conversation before item 9 and answered the same way (wait 5 s, then «Yes»):
- No prompt for P1 (the command ran straight away): send
  `Run the shell command: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('s1-bash-2.txt','ok')" and then reply with exactly: done`.
  If that does not prompt either, stop the spike and ask the user which rule or mode auto-approves
  shell commands; the run gives no verdict.
- No prompt for P2 (the file was written straight away): ask the user to switch the mode to «Ask before

- [ ] **Step 5: Stop the observer and extract the probe lines**

Stop the background task (or let `-DurationSec` end it). Then, PowerShell:
```powershell

$sid = ($log | Select-String -Pattern ([regex]::Escape($file) + ' pid=\d+ sid=(\w+) ') | Select-Object -Last 1).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value
"file=$file sid=$sid"
$log | Where-Object { $_ -match [regex]::Escape($file) -or $_ -match ('TX ' + $sid + ' ') -or $_ -match 'MISSED-NOTIFY|OVERFLOW-OR-ERROR' }
```
Expected shape for a PASS of P1 (values illustrative; every watcher write usually appears twice, Size + LastWrite):
```
10:00:00.120 EVENT Created 41234.json pid=41234 sid=1a2b3c4d entry=claude-vscode host=cursor procStart=match version=2.1.286 cwd=mayak-s1 status=idle waitingFor=- statusUpdatedAt=…
10:00:09.410 EVENT Changed 41234.json … cwd=mayak-s1 status=busy waitingFor=- statusUpdatedAt=…
10:00:09.700 TX 1a2b3c4d @0 type=user side=False stop= apiErr= blocks=string
10:00:12.050 TX 1a2b3c4d @1840 type=assistant side=False stop=tool_use apiErr= blocks=tool_use:Bash#ab12cd
10:00:12.090 EVENT Changed 41234.json … status=waiting waitingFor=permission prompt statusUpdatedAt=…
10:00:12.240 POLL 41234.json status=waiting waitingFor=permission prompt statusUpdatedAt=…
10:00:17.300 EVENT Changed 41234.json … status=busy waitingFor=- statusUpdatedAt=…
10:00:17.420 TX 1a2b3c4d @3105 type=user side=False stop= apiErr= blocks=tool_result#ab12cd
10:00:19.880 TX 1a2b3c4d @3990 type=assistant side=False stop=end_turn apiErr= blocks=text
10:00:19.910 EVENT Changed 41234.json … status=idle waitingFor=- statusUpdatedAt=…
```
P2 follows with the same shape (`blocks=tool_use:Write#…`, its own waiting/busy/idle lines). Records with
`stop=` empty for assistant are streaming fragments; other record types such as `attachment` or `system`
may appear and are ignored by the rule.

- [ ] **Step 6: Apply the decision rule**

Waiting phases, all on the probe file `F`/sid `S` from Step 5, numbered in log order. For phase `k`:
- `tW` = time of the first `EVENT … F … status=waiting` line of the phase (the first one after the previous
  phase's `tI`); `tB` = first `EVENT … F … status=busy` after `tW`; `tI` = first `EVENT … F … status=idle` after `tB`.
- `id6` = the id of the first `TX S … type=user … tool_result#<id6>` line with a time `≥ tB`; `Tool` = the
  tool name of the `TX S … type=assistant … tool_use:<Tool>#<id6>` line with that `id6`.

**P1** is the first phase with `Tool` = `Bash` or `PowerShell` (Claude Code on Windows may run a shell
command with either tool) and **P2** the first phase with `Tool` = `Write`; a phase with
`tB − tW < 2000 ms` (the user answered too fast) does not count, and that probe is sent again in the same
conversation with a new file name (`s1-bash-3.txt` / `s1-probe-3.txt`) before the verdict. If Claude
answered the Write prompt with another tool, so that no phase has `Tool` = `Write`, P2 is
`not exercised (<Tool>)`. The optional AskUserQuestion phase is neither P1 nor P2.

Conditions, evaluated for P1 and for P2 separately, each with its own `tW`, `tB`, `tI`, `id6`, `Tool`:
- **C1 (state + notification):** the `EVENT … F … status=waiting` line at `tW` reads `waitingFor=permission prompt`,
  and the whole log has no `MISSED-NOTIFY F` and no `OVERFLOW-OR-ERROR` line.
- **C2 (tool_use before the answer):** the `TX S … type=assistant … tool_use:<Tool>#<id6>` line has a time `< tB`
  (its `tool_result#<id6>` is at or after `tB` by the definition of `id6`).
- **C3 (final record near idle):** the first `TX S … type=assistant … stop=<v>` line after `tB` with `<v>`
  non-empty and `≠ tool_use` has `|t(that line) − tI| ≤ 2000 ms`.

Verdict of one probe:
- **PASS** — C1, C2 and C3 hold.
- **PASS WITH NOTE** — C2 holds and the only deviations are: (N1) `status=waiting` is reported with a
  `waitingFor` literal other than `permission prompt` (record the exact literal), and/or (N2) the C3 gap is
  between 2 s and 30 s (record it; the late-record rule D51 covers it).
- **FAIL** — any of: (F1) no waiting phase for the probe although the user saw its prompt; (F2) a
  `MISSED-NOTIFY F` or `OVERFLOW-OR-ERROR` line; (F3) the `tool_use` line only after `tB`; (F4) no terminal
  assistant record within 30 s of `tI`.

S1 verdict (P1 decides, because acceptance item 2 and spec §10 «цель кодом» are about commands):
- **FAIL** — P1 is FAIL, or (F5) no session file with `entry=claude-vscode host=cursor` ever appeared.
  → **Stop.** Do not start Task 3. Report to the user the failed condition(s) of P1 (and P2's verdict) and
  the Step 5 lines (metadata only); the Claude path is redesigned with the user (spec §12 S1).
- **PASS** — P1 and P2 are both PASS. → Continue with Task 3.
- **PASS WITH NOTE** — every other case: P1 is PASS WITH NOTE (whatever P2 is), or P1 is PASS and P2 is
  PASS WITH NOTE, FAIL or not exercised. Record P1's N1/N2 and, when P2 is not PASS, as (N3) P2's verdict
  with its failed conditions or notes (an edit approval in the Cursor extension may go through the IDE
  diff UI).
  → Continue with Task 3 and report N3 to the user together with the verdict. An N1 literal seen in
  either probe must be settled with the user before Task 7 (fixtures) and Task 9 (mapping) start:
  Task 7 writes `"permission prompt"` into `session_waiting_permission.json` and its tests, and spec §7
  maps only `"permission prompt"` to `Waiting(Permission)` (another literal would land in
  `Waiting(Other)`, rank 1).

The optional AskUserQuestion probe is informative only: record whether it showed
`waitingFor=input needed` and whether a `tool_use:AskUserQuestion` line preceded it.

- [ ] **Step 7: Record the result and clean up**

Append under `## S1` in `$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/mayak-pr-notes.md` (fill every value from the log):
```markdown
- Date: <yyyy-mm-dd>; Claude Code in Cursor: version=<version field>; entrypoint=<entry field>
- Verdict: <PASS | PASS WITH NOTE | FAIL>; P1 (shell command): <PASS | PASS WITH NOTE | FAIL>; P2 (Write): <PASS | PASS WITH NOTE | FAIL | not exercised (<Tool>)>
```

```rust
//! mayak-hook core — everything the relay does that can be tested without an
//! agent spawning it. `main.rs` only wires argv, stdin and stdout to this.
//!
//! Hard rule: **never block the agent.**
//! * No pipe (Mayak closed) → nothing to say, exit 0 at once.
//! * Every pipe call runs on a worker thread under a deadline (`talk_to`), so a
//!   server that accepts and then stops reading cannot wedge a session.
//! * Only a Claude `PermissionRequest` waits for an answer. Codex never waits and
//!   never gets anything on stdout: the island only watches Codex.

use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::sync::mpsc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

use serde_json::{Map, Value};

pub mod win;

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) mod testutil {
    //! Private copy of the app's `testutil::TempDir` and a std-thread pipe server.

    use std::fs::File;
    use std::io::{Read, Write};
    use std::os::windows::io::FromRawHandle;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
    use std::sync::mpsc;
    use std::thread::JoinHandle;
    use std::time::Duration;

    use windows::core::HSTRING;
    use windows::Win32::Foundation::{ERROR_PIPE_CONNECTED, HANDLE};
    use windows::Win32::Storage::FileSystem::PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX;
    use windows::Win32::System::Pipes::{
        ConnectNamedPipe, CreateNamedPipeW, PIPE_NOWAIT, PIPE_READMODE_BYTE, PIPE_TYPE_BYTE,
        PIPE_WAIT,
    };

    static NEXT: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);

    fn next() -> u32 {
        NEXT.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed)
    }

    /// `\\.\pipe\mayak-test-<tag>-<pid>-<n>` — never the real `mayak-<SID>`.
    pub fn unique_pipe(tag: &str) -> String {
        format!(r"\\.\pipe\mayak-test-{tag}-{}-{}", std::process::id(), next())
    }

    /// One server instance (byte mode, one instance max).
    pub fn create_instance(name: &str, nowait: bool) -> HANDLE {
        let wait = if nowait { PIPE_NOWAIT } else { PIPE_WAIT };
        let h = unsafe {
            CreateNamedPipeW(
                &HSTRING::from(name),
                PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX,
                PIPE_TYPE_BYTE | PIPE_READMODE_BYTE | wait,
                1,
                4096,
                4096,
                0,
                None,
            )
        };
        assert!(!h.is_invalid(), "CreateNamedPipeW failed for {name}");
        h
    }

    /// Server thread: create, signal ready, accept one client, read one line,
    /// write `reply` if any, keep the connection for `hold`, return the line.
    pub fn serve_once(name: &str, reply: Option<&'static str>, hold: Duration) -> JoinHandle<String> {
        let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = mpsc::channel();
        let name = name.to_string();
        let server = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let h = create_instance(&name, false);
            ready_tx.send(()).expect("ready");
            if let Err(err) = unsafe { ConnectNamedPipe(h, None) } {
                assert_eq!(err.code(), ERROR_PIPE_CONNECTED.to_hresult(), "accept failed");
            }
            let mut pipe = unsafe { File::from_raw_handle(h.0) };
            let mut line = Vec::new();
            let mut byte = [0u8; 1];
            while let Ok(1) = pipe.read(&mut byte) {
                line.push(byte[0]);
                if byte[0] == b'\n' {
                    break;
                }
            }
            if let Some(r) = reply {
                pipe.write_all(r.as_bytes()).expect("reply");
                pipe.flush().expect("flush");
            }
            std::thread::sleep(hold);
            String::from_utf8(line).expect("utf-8 line")
        });
        ready_rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5)).expect("server ready");
        server
    }
}

        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
        // PIPE_NOWAIT: still listening means no client ever opened the pipe.
        let err = unsafe { ConnectNamedPipe(h, None) }.unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.code(), ERROR_PIPE_LISTENING.to_hresult());
        unsafe { CloseHandle(h).unwrap() };
    }

        assert_ne!(err.code(), ERROR_PIPE_LISTENING.to_hresult());
```

```rust
/// Longest string forwarded for any single field.
pub const MAX_FIELD_LEN: usize = 2_000;
/// Budget for getting a pipe connection. Beyond this the agent wins, always.
pub const CONNECT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_millis(300);
/// Whole Codex run, connect included. Codex waits on its hooks.
pub const CODEX_BUDGET: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
/// Whole run for a Claude event nobody waits on: connect and write, no more.
pub const FIRE_AND_FORGET_BUDGET: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
/// How long a Claude permission prompt may stay on the island.
pub const DECISION_BUDGET: Duration = Duration::from_secs(110);
/// Ancestor steps searched for `codex.exe`.
pub const MAX_ANCESTOR_STEPS: usize = 6;
/// `relay` field: lets the app tell this relay from the Coucou-era one.
pub const RELAY_VERSION: u64 = 2;
/// (payload key, env var) terminal context, inserted only when absent.
pub const TERM_CONTEXT: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    ("term_program", "TERM_PROGRAM"),
    ("wt_session", "WT_SESSION"),
    ("term_session_id", "TERM_SESSION_ID"),
    ("vscode_pid", "VSCODE_PID"),
    ("session_pid", "CLAUDE_CODE_SSE_PORT"),
];

/// `ERROR_PIPE_BUSY` — every instance is serving someone else right now. The
/// one error worth retrying: the server exists and a slot will free up.
const ERROR_PIPE_BUSY: i32 = 231;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Agent {
    Claude,
    Codex,
}

impl Agent {
    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Agent::Claude => "claude",
            Agent::Codex => "codex",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Args {
    pub agent: Agent,
    pub event: Option<String>,
    pub dump: bool,
}

/// argv without argv[0]: `[--agent claude|codex] [<EventName>]`.
/// A lone `<EventName>` means Claude, as with the Coucou relay.
pub fn parse_args<I: IntoIterator<Item = String>>(args: I) -> Args {
    let mut parsed = Args { agent: Agent::Claude, event: None, dump: false };
    let mut it = args.into_iter();
    while let Some(arg) = it.next() {
        if arg == "--agent" {
            // The value is consumed whatever it is; only "codex" changes anything.
            parsed.agent = match it.next().as_deref() {
                Some("codex") => Agent::Codex,
                _ => Agent::Claude,
            };
        } else if arg == "--dump" {
            // Spike S2 only: the flag does not exist in a release build.
            parsed.dump = cfg!(debug_assertions);
        } else if arg.starts_with("--") {
            // Unknown flag: ignored.
        } else if parsed.event.is_none() {
            parsed.event = Some(arg);
        }
    }
    parsed
}

/// Strips every leading UTF-8 BOM. Some shells add one, some add two.
pub fn strip_boms(raw: &[u8]) -> &[u8] {
    let mut rest = raw;
    while let Some(tail) = rest.strip_prefix(&[0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF]) {
        rest = tail;
    }
    rest
}

/// Non-empty `payload.hook_event_name` wins, else the argv event, else "".
pub fn resolve_event(payload: &Map<String, Value>, arg_event: Option<&str>) -> String {
    payload
        .get("hook_event_name")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .or(arg_event)
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .to_string()
}

/// A `PermissionRequest` carrying `turn_id` comes from Codex whatever argv says:
/// Codex can import Claude's hooks, and an imported Allow/Deny entry must
/// neither wait nor answer Codex.
pub fn detect_agent(arg_agent: Agent, event: &str, payload: &Map<String, Value>) -> Agent {
    let has_turn = payload.get("turn_id").is_some_and(|v| !v.is_null());
    if event == "PermissionRequest" && has_turn {
        Agent::Codex
    } else {
        arg_agent
    }
}

pub fn waits_for_answer(agent: Agent, event: &str) -> bool {
    agent == Agent::Claude && event == "PermissionRequest"
}

pub fn budget(agent: Agent, waits: bool) -> Duration {
    match (agent, waits) {
        (Agent::Codex, _) => CODEX_BUDGET,
        (Agent::Claude, true) => DECISION_BUDGET,
        (Agent::Claude, false) => FIRE_AND_FORGET_BUDGET,
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct AgentProc {
    pub pid: u32,
    pub created_ft: u64,
    pub image: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Enrichment {
    pub agent: Agent,
    pub event: String,
    /// ms since the Unix epoch, UTC.
    pub relay_ts: i64,
    pub cwd_fallback: Option<String>,
    /// Resolved TERM_CONTEXT values.
    pub term: Vec<(&'static str, String)>,
    /// From CLAUDE_PID (Claude only).
    pub claude_pid: Option<u32>,
    /// Ancestor codex.exe (Codex only).
    pub codex_proc: Option<AgentProc>,
}

/// Adds what the app needs and drops what it must not get.
pub fn enrich(payload: &mut Map<String, Value>, e: &Enrichment) {
    payload.insert("hook_event_name".into(), Value::String(e.event.clone()));
    payload.insert("agent".into(), Value::from(e.agent.as_str()));
    payload.insert("relay".into(), Value::from(RELAY_VERSION));
    payload.insert("relay_ts".into(), Value::from(e.relay_ts));
    // A whole file read or command output: never shown, can be enormous.
    payload.remove("tool_response");
    match e.agent {
        Agent::Claude => {
            // The observer reads Claude transcripts itself.
            payload.remove("transcript_path");
            payload.insert("agent_pid".into(), e.claude_pid.map_or(Value::Null, Value::from));
        }
        Agent::Codex => {
            // Codex keeps transcript_path: it is the rollout codex-io tails.
            let p = e.codex_proc.as_ref();
            payload.insert("agent_pid".into(), p.map_or(Value::Null, |p| Value::from(p.pid)));
            payload.insert(
                "agent_created".into(),
                p.map_or(Value::Null, |p| Value::from(p.created_ft)),
            );
            payload.insert(
                "agent_image".into(),
                p.and_then(|p| p.image.clone()).map_or(Value::Null, Value::String),
            );
        }
    }
    let cwd_missing = payload.get("cwd").and_then(Value::as_str).map_or(true, str::is_empty);
    if cwd_missing {
        if let Some(cwd) = &e.cwd_fallback {
            payload.insert("cwd".into(), Value::String(cwd.clone()));
        }
    }
    for (key, value) in &e.term {
        if !payload.contains_key(*key) {
            payload.insert((*key).to_string(), Value::String(value.clone()));
        }
    }
}

/// Caps every string. A single Write can carry a whole file.
pub fn truncate_strings(v: &mut Value) {
    match v {
        Value::String(s) => {
            if s.len() > MAX_FIELD_LEN {
                // Cut on a char boundary; a lone byte index can split UTF-8.
                let mut end = MAX_FIELD_LEN;
                while end > 0 && !s.is_char_boundary(end) {
                    end -= 1;
                }
                s.truncate(end);
                s.push('…');
            }
        }
        Value::Array(items) => items.iter_mut().for_each(truncate_strings),
        Value::Object(map) => map.values_mut().for_each(truncate_strings),
        _ => {}
    }
}

/// Compact JSON + '\n': the wire format of the pipe.
pub fn to_line(payload: &Map<String, Value>) -> String {
    let mut line = Value::Object(payload.clone()).to_string();
    line.push('\n');
    line
}

/// Connect, send, and — when `waits` — read one reply line. Runs on a worker
/// thread; returns None after `budget` at the latest. Never panics.
pub fn talk_to(pipe_name: &str, payload: &str, waits: bool, budget: Duration) -> Option<String> {
    if budget.is_zero() {
        return None;
    }
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<Option<String>>();
    let name = pipe_name.to_string();
    let line = payload.to_string();
    // If the worker overruns, we stop listening; the process exit takes the
    // pipe handle with it.
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let _ = tx.send(talk(&name, &line, waits));
    });
    rx.recv_timeout(budget).ok().flatten()
}

fn talk(pipe_name: &str, payload: &str, waits: bool) -> Option<String> {
    let mut pipe = connect(pipe_name)?;
    pipe.write_all(payload.as_bytes()).ok()?;
    let _ = pipe.flush();
    if !waits {
        return None;
    }
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    let mut chunk = [0u8; 1024];
    loop {
        match pipe.read(&mut chunk) {
            Ok(0) | Err(_) => break,
            Ok(n) => {
                buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]);
                if chunk[..n].contains(&b'\n') {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let answer = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf).trim().to_string();
    (!answer.is_empty()).then_some(answer)
}

/// Opens the pipe. Retries only while the server is busy: any other error means
/// there is nothing to talk to, and waiting would only delay the agent.
fn connect(pipe_name: &str) -> Option<std::fs::File> {
    use std::os::windows::io::AsRawHandle;
    let deadline = Instant::now() + CONNECT_TIMEOUT;
    loop {
        match std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(pipe_name) {
            Ok(file) => {
                let handle = windows::Win32::Foundation::HANDLE(file.as_raw_handle());
                // Somebody else's server on our pipe name gets nothing from us.
                return win::pipe_server_is_same_user(handle).then_some(file);
            }
            Err(err) => {
                if err.raw_os_error() != Some(ERROR_PIPE_BUSY) || Instant::now() >= deadline {
                    return None;
                }
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(15));
            }
        }
    }
}

/// The documented Claude Code PermissionRequest output. Anything unrecognised
/// prints nothing: silence is the safe answer.
pub fn decision_json(decision: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let behavior = match decision.trim() {
        // "always" still answers a plain allow; remembering it is the island's job.
        "allow" | "always" => r#"{"behavior":"allow"}"#.to_string(),
        "deny" => r#"{"behavior":"deny","message":"Denied from Mayak"}"#.to_string(),
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some(format!(
        r#"{{"hookSpecificOutput":{{"hookEventName":"PermissionRequest","decision":{behavior}}}}}"#
    ))
}

/// What to print on stdout. Only a Claude PermissionRequest with a recognised
/// reply prints anything; Codex never does.
pub fn stdout_for(agent: Agent, event: &str, reply: Option<&str>) -> Option<String> {
    if !waits_for_answer(agent, event) {
        return None;
    }
    reply.and_then(decision_json)
}

pub fn unix_ms_now() -> i64 {
    SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_millis() as i64)
        .unwrap_or(0)
}
```

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ProcRow {
    pub pid: u32,
    pub parent_pid: u32,
    /// `szExeFile`: the image file name, no directory.
    pub exe_name: String,
}

/// Toolhelp32 snapshot of every process. Empty on failure.
pub fn process_table() -> Vec<ProcRow> {
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    unsafe {
        let Ok(snapshot) = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0) else {
            return rows;
        };
        let mut entry = PROCESSENTRY32W {
            dwSize: std::mem::size_of::<PROCESSENTRY32W>() as u32,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        if Process32FirstW(snapshot, &mut entry).is_ok() {
            loop {
                let len = entry.szExeFile.iter().position(|c| *c == 0).unwrap_or(entry.szExeFile.len());
                rows.push(ProcRow {
                    pid: entry.th32ProcessID,
                    parent_pid: entry.th32ParentProcessID,
                    exe_name: String::from_utf16_lossy(&entry.szExeFile[..len]),
                });
                if Process32NextW(snapshot, &mut entry).is_err() {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        let _ = CloseHandle(snapshot);
    }
    rows
}

/// Creation time of `pid` as a FILETIME, `(high << 32) | low`.
pub fn creation_ft(pid: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    unsafe {
        let process = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, false, pid).ok()?;
        let mut created = FILETIME::default();
        let mut exited = FILETIME::default();
        let mut kernel = FILETIME::default();
        let mut user = FILETIME::default();
        let ok = GetProcessTimes(process, &mut created, &mut exited, &mut kernel, &mut user).is_ok();
        let _ = CloseHandle(process);
        ok.then(|| ((created.dwHighDateTime as u64) << 32) | created.dwLowDateTime as u64)
    }
}

/// Full Win32 path of the image of `pid`.
pub fn image_path(pid: u32) -> Option<String> {
    unsafe {
        let process = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, false, pid).ok()?;
        let mut buf = vec![0u16; 32_768];
        let mut len = buf.len() as u32;
        let ok = QueryFullProcessImageNameW(process, PROCESS_NAME_WIN32, PWSTR(buf.as_mut_ptr()), &mut len)
            .is_ok();
        let _ = CloseHandle(process);
        ok.then(|| String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..len as usize]))
    }
}

/// Pure ancestor walk over a process table. Starts at `pid` (its row and
/// creation time must exist, else empty). Each step needs the parent's row and
/// creation time, and the parent must be strictly older than the child: a
/// younger "parent" is a reused PID, and the walk stops there. Nearest first.
pub fn ancestors(
    rows: &[ProcRow],
    created: impl Fn(u32) -> Option<u64>,
    pid: u32,
    max: usize,
) -> Vec<(ProcRow, u64)> {
    let mut chain = Vec::new();
    let Some(mut child) = rows.iter().find(|r| r.pid == pid) else { return chain };
    let Some(mut child_ft) = created(pid) else { return chain };
    while chain.len() < max {
        let Some(parent) = rows.iter().find(|r| r.pid == child.parent_pid) else { break };
        let Some(parent_ft) = created(parent.pid) else { break };
        if parent_ft >= child_ft {
            break;
        }
        chain.push((parent.clone(), parent_ft));
        child = parent;
        child_ft = parent_ft;
    }
    chain
}

fn is_codex(exe_name: &str) -> bool {
    exe_name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("codex.exe")
}

/// The nearest `codex.exe` among the first MAX_ANCESTOR_STEPS ancestors of `pid`.
pub fn find_codex_ancestor(pid: u32) -> Option<crate::AgentProc> {
    ancestors(&process_table(), creation_ft, pid, crate::MAX_ANCESTOR_STEPS)
        .into_iter()
        .find(|(row, _)| is_codex(&row.exe_name))
        .map(|(row, created_ft)| crate::AgentProc {
            pid: row.pid,
            created_ft,
            image: image_path(row.pid),
        })
}
```

```rust
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;

const K: [u32; 64] = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
];

/// SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4), written out to avoid a crate for a debug-only feature.
pub fn sha256(data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut h: [u32; 8] = [
        0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab,
        0x5be0cd19,
    ];
    let bit_len = (data.len() as u64).wrapping_mul(8);
    let mut msg = data.to_vec();
    msg.push(0x80);
    while msg.len() % 64 != 56 {
        msg.push(0);
    }
    msg.extend_from_slice(&bit_len.to_be_bytes());

    for block in msg.chunks_exact(64) {
        let mut w = [0u32; 64];
        for (i, word) in block.chunks_exact(4).enumerate() {
            w[i] = u32::from_be_bytes([word[0], word[1], word[2], word[3]]);
        }
        for i in 16..64 {
            let s0 = w[i - 15].rotate_right(7) ^ w[i - 15].rotate_right(18) ^ (w[i - 15] >> 3);
            let s1 = w[i - 2].rotate_right(17) ^ w[i - 2].rotate_right(19) ^ (w[i - 2] >> 10);
            w[i] = w[i - 16].wrapping_add(s0).wrapping_add(w[i - 7]).wrapping_add(s1);
        }
        let [mut a, mut b, mut c, mut d, mut e, mut f, mut g, mut hh] = h;
        for i in 0..64 {
            let s1 = e.rotate_right(6) ^ e.rotate_right(11) ^ e.rotate_right(25);
            let ch = (e & f) ^ (!e & g);
            let t1 = hh.wrapping_add(s1).wrapping_add(ch).wrapping_add(K[i]).wrapping_add(w[i]);
            let s0 = a.rotate_right(2) ^ a.rotate_right(13) ^ a.rotate_right(22);
            let maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
            let t2 = s0.wrapping_add(maj);
            hh = g;
            g = f;
            f = e;
            e = d.wrapping_add(t1);
            d = c;
            c = b;
            b = a;
            a = t1.wrapping_add(t2);
        }
        for (x, y) in h.iter_mut().zip([a, b, c, d, e, f, g, hh]) {
            *x = x.wrapping_add(y);
        }
    }

    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    for (i, word) in h.iter().enumerate() {
        out[4 * i..4 * i + 4].copy_from_slice(&word.to_be_bytes());
    }
    out
}

/// Lowercase hex.
pub fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
}

/// `<now_ms> len=<n> sha256=<hex> age_ms=<age> chain=<a>b>c> shell=<chain[0] or '-'>`.
/// `chain` = ancestor exe names, nearest first. The stdin content is never written.
pub fn dump_line(stdin: &[u8], age_ms: i64, chain: &[String], now_ms: i64) -> String {
    format!(
        "{now_ms} len={} sha256={} age_ms={age_ms} chain={} shell={}",
        stdin.len(),
        hex(&sha256(stdin)),
        chain.join(">"),
        chain.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("-"),
    )
}

/// Appends one line, creating the parent folder.
pub fn append(path: &Path, line: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    if let Some(dir) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
    }
    let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path)?;
    writeln!(file, "{line}")
}

```

Replace the whole of `windows/hook/src/main.rs` with (the deadline starts at the first statement,

```rust
//! mayak-hook — the relay Claude Code and Codex run on hook events.
//!
//! Reads the hook JSON on stdin, adds what Mayak needs, and hands it to Mayak
//! over `\\.\pipe\mayak-<sid>`. The logic lives in `lib.rs`; this file only
//! wires argv, stdin and stdout to it.
//!
//! Hard rule: **never block the agent.** Mayak closed → exit 0 at once with
//! nothing on stdout. Only a Claude `PermissionRequest` waits for an answer;
//! Codex is never answered.
//!
//! Usage: `mayak-hook [--agent claude|codex] [<EventName>]`
//! (debug builds also take `--dump`, spike S2).

#[allow(dead_code)]
#[path = "../../ident.rs"]
mod ident;

use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::time::Instant;

use mayak_hook::{self as relay, win, Agent, Enrichment};

/// `\\.\pipe\mayak-<sid>` — must match the app's `pipe::pipe_name()` exactly.
fn pipe_path() -> String {
    let key = win::current_user_sid()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::env::var("USERNAME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "user".into()));
    format!(r"\\.\pipe\{}{key}", ident::PIPE_PREFIX)
}

fn main() {
    // The budget is a deadline from here: stdin, the ancestor walk and the
    // enrichment all count against it.
    let started = Instant::now();
    let args = relay::parse_args(std::env::args().skip(1));

    let mut raw = Vec::new();
    if std::io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut raw).is_err() || raw.is_empty() {
        std::process::exit(0);
    }
    let body = relay::strip_boms(&raw);

    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    if args.dump {
        dump(&raw);
    }

    let Ok(serde_json::Value::Object(mut payload)) = serde_json::from_slice(body) else {
        std::process::exit(0);
    };
    let event = relay::resolve_event(&payload, args.event.as_deref());
    let agent = relay::detect_agent(args.agent, &event, &payload);
    let codex_proc = match agent {
        Agent::Codex => win::find_codex_ancestor(std::process::id()),
        Agent::Claude => None,
    };
    let claude_pid = match agent {
        Agent::Claude => std::env::var("CLAUDE_PID").ok().and_then(|v| v.trim().parse().ok()),
        Agent::Codex => None,
    };
    let enrichment = Enrichment {
        agent,
        event: event.clone(),
        relay_ts: relay::unix_ms_now(),
        cwd_fallback: std::env::current_dir().ok().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned()),
        term: relay::TERM_CONTEXT
            .iter()
            .map(|(key, var)| (*key, std::env::var(var).unwrap_or_default()))
            .collect(),
        claude_pid,
        codex_proc,
    };
    relay::enrich(&mut payload, &enrichment);
    payload.values_mut().for_each(relay::truncate_strings);

    let waits = relay::waits_for_answer(agent, &event);
    let remaining = relay::budget(agent, waits).saturating_sub(started.elapsed());
    let reply = relay::talk_to(&pipe_path(), &relay::to_line(&payload), waits, remaining);

    if let Some(json) = relay::stdout_for(agent, &event, reply.as_deref()) {
        let mut out = std::io::stdout();
        let _ = writeln!(out, "{json}");
        let _ = out.flush();
    }
    // Nothing printed: the agent asks in its own UI, as if Mayak were not here.
    std::process::exit(0);
}

/// Spike S2: one measurement line in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Mayak\dump.log`.
#[cfg(debug_assertions)]
fn dump(stdin: &[u8]) {
    use mayak_hook::dump;

    let Some(base) = std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA") else {
        eprintln!("mayak-hook: --dump needs LOCALAPPDATA");
        return;
    };
    let path = std::path::PathBuf::from(base).join(ident::APP_DIR).join("dump.log");
    let pid = std::process::id();
    let chain: Vec<String> =
        win::ancestors(&win::process_table(), win::creation_ft, pid, relay::MAX_ANCESTOR_STEPS)
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(row, _)| row.exe_name)
            .collect();
    let now = relay::unix_ms_now();
    // FILETIME (100 ns since 1601) → Unix ms; -1 when the creation time is unreadable.
    let age = win::creation_ft(pid)
        .map(|ft| now - ((ft / 10_000) as i64 - 11_644_473_600_000))
        .unwrap_or(-1);
    if let Err(err) = dump::append(&path, &dump::dump_line(stdin, age, &chain, now)) {
        eprintln!("mayak-hook: dump failed: {err}");
    }
}
```

```rust
/// `claude:<pid>:<created_ft>` or `codex:<session_id>`.
pub type SessionKey = String;

/// A Claude session is its `claude.exe` process: pid plus creation FILETIME
/// (decimal), so a reused pid never inherits an old row.
pub fn claude_key(pid: u32, created_ft: u64) -> SessionKey {
    format!("claude:{pid}:{created_ft}")
}

/// A Codex session is its `session_id`; subagents share the parent's.
pub fn codex_key(session_id: &str) -> SessionKey {
    format!("codex:{session_id}")
}
```

```rust
        }
    }

    /// Reads until the server closes its end; returns what it wrote.
    async fn read_to_close(c: &mut NamedPipeClient) -> String {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut chunk = [0u8; 256];
        loop {
            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), c.read(&mut chunk)).await {
                Ok(Ok(0)) | Ok(Err(_)) => break,
                Ok(Ok(n)) => out.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]),
                Err(_) => panic!("server never closed the connection"),
            }
        }
        String::from_utf8(out).unwrap()
    }

    async fn recv(rx: &mut UnboundedReceiver<Value>) -> Value {
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), rx.recv()).await.expect("timed out").expect("closed")
    }

    #[test]
    fn route_table() {
        assert_eq!(route("codex", "PermissionRequest"), Route::Observe);
        assert_eq!(route("codex", "Stop"), Route::Observe);
        assert_eq!(route("codex", ""), Route::Observe);
        assert_eq!(route("claude", "PermissionRequest"), Route::Approval);
        assert_eq!(route("claude", "Stop"), Route::Ignore);
        assert_eq!(route("claude", "UserPromptSubmit"), Route::Ignore);
        assert_eq!(route("claude", ""), Route::Ignore);
        assert_eq!(route("cursor", "PermissionRequest"), Route::Ignore);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_line_takes_one_object_line() {
        assert_eq!(parse_line(b"{\"a\":1}\ntrailing").unwrap(), json!({ "a": 1 }));
        assert_eq!(parse_line(b"{\"a\":1}").unwrap(), json!({ "a": 1 }));
        assert_eq!(
            parse_line(b"[1,2]\n"),
            Err(LineError::Invalid { len: 5, reason: "not a JSON object".into() })
        );
        match parse_line(b"not json at all\n") {
            Err(LineError::Invalid { len: 15, reason }) => {
                assert!(reason.starts_with("Syntax error"), "{reason}");
                assert!(!reason.contains("not json"), "{reason}");
            }
            other => panic!("{other:?}"),
        }
        assert!(matches!(parse_line(b""), Err(LineError::Invalid { len: 0, .. })));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_line_refuses_more_than_one_mebibyte() {
        let mut big = vec![b' '; MAX_PAYLOAD + 1];
        big[0] = b'{';
        assert_eq!(parse_line(&big), Err(LineError::Oversize(MAX_PAYLOAD + 1)));
        // Exactly 1 MiB is still a line.
        let mut edge = vec![b' '; MAX_PAYLOAD];
        edge[0] = b'{';
        edge[MAX_PAYLOAD - 1] = b'}';
        assert_eq!(parse_line(&edge).unwrap(), json!({}));
    }

    #[test]
    fn annotations_are_strings_or_nulls() {
        let mut p = json!({ "hook_event_name": "PermissionRequest" });
        annotate_approval(&mut p, "9-1", &ApprovalContext::default());
        assert_eq!(p["request_id"], "9-1");
        assert_eq!(p["session_key"], Value::Null);
        assert_eq!(p["project_name"], Value::Null);
        let ctx = ApprovalContext { session_key: Some("claude:1:2".into()), project_name: Some("mayak".into()) };
        annotate_approval(&mut p, "9-2", &ctx);
        assert_eq!(p["session_key"], "claude:1:2");
        assert_eq!(p["project_name"], "mayak");
    }

    #[test]
    fn log_lines_carry_no_payload() {
        assert_eq!(log_line_for("codex", "Stop", Some("0199a1b2-c3d4")), "hook codex Stop s=0199a1b2");
        assert_eq!(log_line_for("claude", "PermissionRequest", Some("abc")), "hook claude PermissionRequest s=abc");
        assert_eq!(log_line_for("claude", "Stop", None), "hook claude Stop s=-");
        assert_eq!(log_line_for("claude", "Stop", Some("")), "hook claude Stop s=-");
    }

    #[test]
    fn serve_future_is_send_for_the_tauri_runtime() {
        fn assert_send<T: Send>(_: &T) {}
        let (s, _o, _a) = sink(ApprovalContext::default());
        let fut = serve(unique_pipe("send"), s);
        assert_send(&fut);
    }

    #[test]
    fn codex_lines_go_to_the_observer_and_are_never_answered() {
        runtime().block_on(async {
            let name = unique_pipe("observe");
            let (s, mut observed, mut shown) = sink(ApprovalContext::default());
            let server = tokio::spawn(serve(name.clone(), s.clone()));
            for session in ["s-one", "s-two"] {
                let mut c = client(&name).await;
                let line = format!("{{\"agent\":\"codex\",\"hook_event_name\":\"PermissionRequest\",\"session_id\":\"{session}\"}}\n");
                c.write_all(line.as_bytes()).await.unwrap();
                assert_eq!(read_to_close(&mut c).await, "");
                assert_eq!(recv(&mut observed).await["session_id"], session);
            }
            assert!(shown.try_recv().is_err());
            assert!(s.pending.0.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
            server.abort();
        });

    #[test]
    fn claude_permission_request_waits_for_the_island_decision() {
        runtime().block_on(async {
            let name = unique_pipe("approval");
            let ctx = ApprovalContext { session_key: Some("claude:7:8".into()), project_name: Some("repo".into()) };
            let (s, mut observed, mut shown) = sink(ctx);
            let server = tokio::spawn(serve(name.clone(), s.clone()));
            let mut c = client(&name).await;

                .await

            let id = card["request_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();

    fn an_unacknowledged_card_lets_the_terminal_take_over() {

                let big = vec![b'x'; MAX_PAYLOAD + 64 * 1024];

            });
            let mut c = writer.await.unwrap();
            let _ = read_to_close(&mut c).await;
            let oversize = notes_with("relay line dropped: oversize ");
            assert_eq!(oversize.len(), 1, "{oversize:?}");

            assert!(observed.try_recv().is_err());
            assert!(shown.try_recv().is_err());
            server.abort();
```
